cover.art: Millie looks up, both hands holding the yellow hat on her head as the wind tips the white daisy sideways; Beans at her feet; a little blue bird flies across the top right.
cover.alt: Millie holds her yellow hat in the wind, with Beans at her feet and a little blue bird flying by.

units.text:
Millie had a yellow hat.
Wherever she went, the hat went too.
units.art: Millie stands at her front door in the yellow hat, Beans wagging at her feet; by the path the branches already bend in the wind and the clouds race.
units.alt: Millie stands at her door in her yellow hat, with Beans at her feet, as the wind bends the trees.

units.text:
Whoosh! The wind blew, and off went the hat!
“My hat!”
units.art: The yellow hat tumbles through the air, daisy down; Millie lunges after it with her arms out, and Beans leaps with all four paws off the ground.
units.alt: The wind carries the yellow hat into the air as Millie reaches for it and Beans jumps.

units.text:
The hat landed in a puddle.
A mouse hopped in.
“This is my boat,” said the mouse.
units.art: The hat floats upside down in a shallow puddle with the mouse inside, rowing with a twig; Beans lies at the edge, nose almost in the water; Millie has just run up.
units.alt: A mouse rows the floating yellow hat across a puddle while Beans watches from the edge.

units.text:
“That's my hat!” said Millie.
Whoosh! The wind blew, and off went the hat again!
units.art: The hat lifts out of the puddle, shaking off drops; the mouse stands on the bank hugging its twig, mouth open; Millie and Beans run after the hat again.
units.alt: The wind lifts the hat out of the puddle while the mouse watches it fly away.
units.turn: Where will it land this time?

units.text:
It began to rain.
“This is my umbrella,” said the frog.
units.art: In a light rain the hat sits brim-down on the grass, the frog's eyes peeking out from under it; Millie crouches beside it with her hair getting wet.
units.alt: In the rain, a frog hides under the yellow hat on the grass while Millie crouches beside it.

units.text:
“That's my hat!” said Millie.
Whoosh! The wind blew, and off went the hat again!
units.art: The wind flips the hat up, the frog dives into the grass covering its head, Millie's hands close on nothing, and Beans runs ahead barking.
units.alt: The wind flips the yellow hat off the frog, and Millie's hands grab only air.
units.turn: This time the hat flew higher.

units.text:
Up, up went the hat,
and caught on a branch.
units.art: A huge tree fills the spread, with the yellow hat tiny on a branch at the top right; Millie and Beans look very small underneath.
units.alt: The yellow hat hangs high in a big tree while Millie and Beans look up from below.

units.text:
Millie stood on tiptoe.
She couldn't reach.
Beans jumped.
He couldn't reach either.
units.art: Millie stretches on tiptoe under the tree, arm straight up; Beans is in mid-jump with his ears flying; the hat is still far above.
units.alt: Millie stretches on tiptoe and Beans jumps, but neither can reach the hat in the tree.

units.text:
A little blue bird flew down
with a twig in its beak.
It put the twig in the hat.
units.art: A little blue bird flies down with a twig in its beak and puts the twig in the hat.
units.alt: A little blue bird carries a twig into the yellow hat in the tree.
units.turn: What does the bird want with the hat?

units.text:
“That's my hat,” Millie whispered.
The bird tilted its head and looked at her.
units.art: Close-up: the bird on the brim, head tilted, a blade of grass in its beak; below, Millie looks up with a frown.
units.alt: The bird tilts its head on the hat's brim as Millie frowns up at it.
units.turn: Millie watched the bird fly off, and come back.

units.art: Wordless. A row of small pictures: the bird brings twigs, dry grass and a feather, trip after trip, and the nest fills the hat; Millie's frown turns into a dreamy stare while Beans falls asleep at her feet.
units.alt: Trip after trip, the bird fills the hat with twigs and grass while Millie watches.

units.text:
Millie thought for a long time.
“You can keep it,” she said.
units.art: Millie waves up at the tree, a little sad; the bird spreads its wings at the edge of the nest; Beans tilts his head at Millie.
units.alt: Millie waves to the little blue bird, and it spreads its wings.

units.text:
On the way home, the wind was still blowing.
Millie's head felt cool.
Beans brought her a blue feather.
units.art: The path at dusk: Millie, hatless, her hair blown about; Beans looks up with a sky-blue feather in his mouth; far behind, a speck of yellow in the big tree.
units.alt: At dusk, Millie walks home without her hat, and Beans brings her a blue feather.

units.text:
Winter came, and went.
Millie often visited the tree.
Whoosh! The wind blew,
and the hat stayed put.
units.art: Left page: the tree in snow, a little snow on the yellow hat; right page: early spring, new buds; Millie and Beans under the tree on both pages, the blue feather tucked behind Millie's ear.
units.alt: From winter to early spring, Millie and Beans visit the tree with the yellow hat in it.
units.turn: A tiny cheeping came from the tree.

units.art: Wordless. In the spring tree, three baby birds with open beaks peek out of the yellow-hat nest, the white daisy still on the brim; Millie and Beans look up from below, and Millie is smiling.
units.alt: Three baby birds peek out of the yellow-hat nest as Millie and Beans smile up at them.
